items.name: Student Support Centre
items.description: Book a counselling appointment by phone, email, or visiting SSC. For urgent assistance, use the Emergency page; SSC does not provide emergency services.
steps: Call 0820-2922430 during office hours or email student.support@manipal.edu.
Visit No. 125, opposite New International Guest House, for appointment enquiries.
Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 7 pm, except third Saturdays and MAHE holidays.

items.name: Student Health Clinic & Medicare
items.description: Find routine medical care at the first floor of the New Outpatient block, Kasturba Hospital. Call 0820-2922057 for an appointment and carry your student ID.
items.appliesTo: Review the official Medicare guidance for coverage and exclusions.

items.name: Student Council & Peer Support
items.description: Find Student Teaching Student, the Mentorship Programme, Career Development Center, and Club Expo through MIT Student Council.
steps: Email president.scmit@manipal.edu to enquire about the programme you need.
The Student Council office is on the ground floor of Academic Block 1.

items.name: Anti-Ragging Committee
items.description: Find MIT's anti-ragging committee and published contact route for reporting ragging concerns.

items.name: Sexual Harassment Complaints Committee
items.description: Open the official committee page for published members and contact details when seeking help or reporting sexual harassment.

items.name: MIT Campus Hostel Information
items.description: Find the official hostel office contact and linked hostel fee documents. Check the academic year on each fee schedule.
